text_en: To the leader: with stringed instruments. A Psalm of David.
text_cn: 达味诗歌，交与乐官，和以弦乐。

text_en: Answer me when I call, O God of my right! You gave me room when I was in distress. Be gracious to me, and hear my prayer.
text_cn: 我公义的天主！ 我一呼求你，你就应允了我， 我在困苦中，你曾舒畅了我。 求你怜悯我，求你俯听我祷。

text_en: How long, you people, shall my honor suffer shame? How long will you love vain words, and seek after lies? Selah
text_cn: 显贵的人们，你们的心要硬到几时？ 你们爱慕虚幻，追求虚伪究竟何为？ （休止）

text_en: But know that the Lord has set apart the faithful for himself; the Lord hears when I call to him.
text_cn: 你们当知：上主特爱对他虔敬的人， 当我呼求上主的时候，他一定俯允。

text_en: When you are disturbed, do not sin; ponder it on your beds, and be silent. Selah
text_cn: 你们应战栗，不可一再作恶， 在床上检讨，且要扪心思过。 （休止）

text_en: Offer right sacrifices, and put your trust in the Lord .
text_cn: 奉上正义的祭献， 对上主全心依盼。

text_en: There are many who say, “O that we might see some good! Let the light of your face shine on us, O Lord ! ”
text_cn: 有许多人说：“谁能使我们幸福亨通？” 上主，望你向我们显你光辉的仪容。

text_en: You have put gladness in my heart more than when their grain and wine abound.
text_cn: 你赐给我心中的欢跃， 远胜过麦和酒的丰饶。

text_en: I will both lie down and sleep in peace; for you alone, O Lord , make me lie down in safety.
text_cn: 在平安中我一躺下即刻入睡， 上主，唯有你能使我安居顺遂。
